title: Criteria built as "="&label over digit-bearing text with non-date/exponent letters evaluate as text rather than failing coercion
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088 under en-ZA, printable-ASCII digit-bearing labels that also contain a run of ASCII letters outside month names/prefixes (3+ letters), A, P, AM, PM, E, and R (such as "2016-17 Winter" or "Q1 2016") fail arithmetic coercion with #VALUE! but are unambiguously text in criteria: COUNTIF, COUNTIFS, SUMIF, SUMIFS, AVERAGEIF, AVERAGEIFS, MAXIFS, and MINIFS match "="&label as text equality and do not match the number 2016 against "2016-17 Winter". Meanwhile "10:30 a" coerces to 0.4375.
basis: Measured on 1,144 readings in dc_e00t in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 (en-ZA) and matched across full-bank rows (COUNTIF 4,253/4,253, COUNTIFS 1,399/1,399, SUMIF 5,561/5,561, SUMIFS 1,400/1,400, AVERAGEIF 4,212/4,212, AVERAGEIFS 1,400/1,400, MAXIFS 1,400/1,400, MINIFS 1,400/1,400).
